title: Database-Safe Contact Concurrency and Distributed Idempotency Amendment

A5.acceptanceScope: Contact persistence, outbox delivery worker, rate limiting, and sliding window idempotency

A6.acceptanceScope: Full-stack integration, web form submission, and baseline verification

defectDescription: During G6 platform verification, an in-process KeyedMutex was introduced to solve concurrent replay races. This was insufficient for multi-process Node workers, serverless functions, and containerized clusters where memory is not shared across instances. The database must serve as the authoritative race arbiter.
governanceResolution: Bounded amendment A5/A6-CONTACT-IDEMPOTENCY-R2 supersedes the in-process mutex approach, making PostgreSQL transactional semantics and atomic key claiming the authoritative distributed race arbiter.

governanceGate.nextStep: GPT Plus #2 delta audit (maker cannot self-approve)
